name: Alan Turing · Jump with the contents
intro: Welcome. We will find Alan Turing and jump from his article's contents to his career and research.

steps.title: Open Wikipedia
steps.say: I type Wikipedia's address in the empty Chrome tab.

steps.title: Search for Alan Turing
steps.say: I move to Wikipedia's search field and type Alan Turing. The matching article appears below the field.

steps.title: Open the Alan Turing article
steps.say: I click the result in the search suggestions and check the article heading.

steps.title: Jump to Career and research
steps.say: I click Career and research in the article's table of contents.

steps.title: Click the tab's close button
steps.say: I close the tab with its close button.

description: Find Alan Turing, use the article's contents to jump to Career and research, and close the tab.
